title: The Marrowgate envoy at Highward grants the Regent's writ for 'two honest services to this Watch' but never itemizes which two of my actions satisfied it (killing the Lost Sentry and reporting it to Sergeant Hale seem the likely pair, but the game never confirms this), leaving the tally opaque.
